process.title: How the repair works
process.subtitle: A simple and transparent process — from inquiry to a fixed device
process.step1_desc: Call, message, or walk in — we respond quickly and help you find the best solution.
process.step2_desc: We carefully inspect the device and pinpoint the issue. Diagnostics are completely free.
process.step3_desc: We explain the problem and propose solutions. Repair starts only with your approval.
process.step4_desc: We replace the part and perform the repair with professional tools. Most repairs take 20–60 minutes.
process.step5_desc: We test all functionality and hand over the device with a 6-month warranty on the work done.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions? Find answers to the most common ones here.
faq.q1: How long does a repair take?
faq.a1: Most repairs are completed in 20–60 minutes. Screen replacement from 20 minutes, battery replacement from 30 minutes. More complex cases may take up to 24 hours.
faq.a2: We offer both genuine Apple parts and high-quality alternatives. You can choose the option that best fits your budget and needs.
faq.q3: What warranty is provided on repairs?
faq.a3: We provide a 6-month warranty on all repairs. If the same issue recurs, we fix it again at no charge.
faq.a4: Yes, diagnostics are completely free. Even if you decide not to proceed with the repair, there is no charge for checking the device.
faq.q5: Can I walk in without an appointment?
faq.a5: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. However, to avoid waiting, you can call or message us in advance.
